open_questions: an all-cash decision writes no row to either store; two consecutive observe nights have produced nothing gradeable (since 2026-09-08)
lessons: a decision to hold nothing is still a decision, and a system that records only non-empty decisions cannot grade its own caution
when evidence is unusable rather than absent the honest position is the same, but the two must not read alike afterwards or a fixable data fault gets filed as a quiet market
a falling share price raises the round-trip hurdle on a fixed-lot market: the ticket shrinks, the per-share and minimum costs do not
